cursor.description: The cursor from the last operation response. Omit it on the first status call.

operation_id.description: The operation id that posthog-agent-run returned.

project_id.description: The project id of the operation, from the `project.id` field of the operation.

wait_seconds.description: How long this status request waits for a change, from 0 to 50 seconds. The request returns early when the operation changes. When your client receives progress updates, any value above 0 follows the run until it finishes or needs the user, up to 10 minutes. This limit applies to one status request, not to the task.
